content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(LA.VectorSpace(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Type.annotation(@v, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), Logic.iff(LA.LinearlyIndependent(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, LA.Singleton(v), $1$), Neq(v, LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace))))

values.zh-CN: 单元素向量族 {v} 线性无关当且仅当 v ≠ 0。
values.en: The singleton family {v} is independent iff v ≠ 0.
